# spartan

> spartan is a collection of tools to supercharge your Angular full-stack development. It provides accessible UI primitives (spartan/ui) built with signals, SSR compatible, and zoneless ready. Built with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Angular CDK. It uses a unique two-layer architecture: install the behavior (brain), copy the styles (helm). Open Source. AI-Ready. It also comes with a command-line tool to install and manage components and an optional full-stack setup (spartan/stack).

## Overview
- [Introduction](https://spartan.ng/documentation/introduction): Core principles—accessible UI primitives, two-layer architecture (brain/helm), and full-stack development with spartan/stack.
- [CLI](https://spartan.ng/documentation/cli): Command-line tool for installing and managing components with automatic setup.
- [Installation](https://spartan.ng/documentation/installation): Quick start guide and manual setup instructions for adding spartan/ui to Angular projects.
- [Theming](https://spartan.ng/documentation/theming): Guide to customizing colors using CSS variables and the background/foreground convention.
- [Dark Mode](https://spartan.ng/documentation/dark-mode): Adding dark mode support to your application.
- [Typography](https://spartan.ng/documentation/typography): Typography styles for headings, paragraphs, lists, and more.
- [Changelog](https://spartan.ng/documentation/changelog): Release notes and version history.
- [About](https://spartan.ng/documentation/about): Credits and acknowledgments for the open source projects that power spartan.

## Architecture
- [spartan/ui/brain](https://spartan.ng/documentation/introduction): Unstyled, accessible primitives installed via npm. Handles ARIA attributes, keyboard navigation, and focus management. Regular dependency with updates and maintenance included.
- [spartan/ui/helm](https://spartan.ng/documentation/introduction): Styled components with a shadcn-inspired design system. Built with Tailwind CSS classes you can edit directly. Lives in your codebase for complete customization.
- [spartan/stack](https://spartan.ng/stack): Optional full-stack setup with AnalogJs, Supabase, tRPC, Tailwind, Nx, and Drizzle for end-to-end type-safe development.

## Components

### Form & Input
- [Field](https://spartan.ng/components/field): Field component for form inputs with labels and error messages.
- [Button](https://spartan.ng/components/button): Button component with multiple variants.
- [Button Group](https://spartan.ng/components/button-group): Group multiple buttons together.
- [Input](https://spartan.ng/components/input): Text input component.
- [Input Group](https://spartan.ng/components/input-group): Input component with prefix and suffix addons.
- [Input OTP](https://spartan.ng/components/input-otp): One-time password input component.
- [Textarea](https://spartan.ng/components/textarea): Multi-line text input component.
- [Checkbox](https://spartan.ng/components/checkbox): Checkbox input component.
- [Radio Group](https://spartan.ng/components/radio-group): Radio button group component.
- [Select](https://spartan.ng/components/select): Select dropdown component.
- [Native Select](https://spartan.ng/components/native-select): Styled native HTML select element.
- [Switch](https://spartan.ng/components/switch): Toggle switch component.
- [Slider](https://spartan.ng/components/slider): Slider input component.
- [Calendar](https://spartan.ng/components/calendar): Calendar component for date selection.
- [Date Picker](https://spartan.ng/components/date-picker): Date picker component combining input and calendar.
- [Combobox](https://spartan.ng/components/combobox): Searchable select component with autocomplete.
- [Autocomplete](https://spartan.ng/components/autocomplete): Autocomplete input component.
- [Label](https://spartan.ng/components/label): Form label component.

### Layout & Navigation
- [Accordion](https://spartan.ng/components/accordion): Collapsible accordion component.
- [Breadcrumb](https://spartan.ng/components/breadcrumb): Breadcrumb navigation component.
- [Navigation Menu](https://spartan.ng/components/navigation-menu): Accessible navigation menu with dropdowns.
- [Sidebar](https://spartan.ng/components/sidebar): Collapsible sidebar component for app layouts.
- [Tabs](https://spartan.ng/components/tabs): Tabbed interface component.
- [Separator](https://spartan.ng/components/separator): Visual divider between content sections.
- [Scroll Area](https://spartan.ng/components/scroll-area): Custom scrollable area with styled scrollbars.
- [Resizable](https://spartan.ng/components/resizable): Resizable panel layout component.

### Overlays & Dialogs
- [Dialog](https://spartan.ng/components/dialog): Modal dialog component.
- [Alert Dialog](https://spartan.ng/components/alert-dialog): Alert dialog for confirmation prompts.
- [Sheet](https://spartan.ng/components/sheet): Slide-out panel component (drawer).
- [Popover](https://spartan.ng/components/popover): Floating popover component.
- [Tooltip](https://spartan.ng/components/tooltip): Tooltip component for additional context.
- [Hover Card](https://spartan.ng/components/hover-card): Card that appears on hover.
- [Context Menu](https://spartan.ng/components/context-menu): Right-click context menu.
- [Dropdown Menu](https://spartan.ng/components/dropdown-menu): Dropdown menu component.
- [Menubar](https://spartan.ng/components/menubar): Horizontal menubar component.
- [Command](https://spartan.ng/components/command): Command palette component.

### Feedback & Status
- [Alert](https://spartan.ng/components/alert): Alert component for messages and notifications.
- [Sonner (Toast)](https://spartan.ng/components/sonner): Toast notification component.
- [Progress](https://spartan.ng/components/progress): Progress bar component.
- [Spinner](https://spartan.ng/components/spinner): Loading spinner component.
- [Skeleton](https://spartan.ng/components/skeleton): Skeleton loading placeholder.
- [Badge](https://spartan.ng/components/badge): Badge component for labels and status indicators.
- [Empty](https://spartan.ng/components/empty): Empty state component for no data scenarios.

### Display & Media
- [Avatar](https://spartan.ng/components/avatar): Avatar component for user profiles.
- [Card](https://spartan.ng/components/card): Card container component.
- [Table](https://spartan.ng/components/table): Table component for displaying data.
- [Data Table](https://spartan.ng/components/data-table): Advanced data table with sorting, filtering, and pagination.
- [Carousel](https://spartan.ng/components/carousel): Carousel component for image galleries.
- [Aspect Ratio](https://spartan.ng/components/aspect-ratio): Container that maintains aspect ratio.
- [Icon](https://spartan.ng/components/icon): Icon component for displaying icons.
- [Item](https://spartan.ng/components/item): Generic item component for lists and menus.
- [Kbd](https://spartan.ng/components/kbd): Keyboard shortcut display component.

### Misc
- [Collapsible](https://spartan.ng/components/collapsible): Collapsible container component.
- [Toggle](https://spartan.ng/components/toggle): Toggle button component.
- [Toggle Group](https://spartan.ng/components/toggle-group): Group of toggle buttons.
- [Pagination](https://spartan.ng/components/pagination): Pagination component for lists and tables.
